blocks.content: Indian Railways operates the fourth-largest national railway network in the world by size.

items: Frequently asked: Match the Railway Zones with their correct headquarters (e.g., South Eastern Railway is headquartered in Kolkata).
Important distinction: The first electric train in India (Deccan Queen) ran on February 3, 1925, between Bombay VT and Kurla.
High frequency concept: UNESCO World Heritage Mountain Railways of India include Darjeeling Himalayan, Nilgiri Mountain, and Kalka-Shimla railways.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1950 and is currently divided into 18 administrative zones.
The Railway Board was constituted in 1905 based on the recommendations of the Robertson Committee.
The mascot of Indian Railways is 'Bholu', an elephant guard holding a green signal lamp.
